title: Ultimate Futsal Manager – Building an FM-style futsal manager with AI tools (now on Steam Wishlist)
author: PapaPrimas
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I want to introduce a project I’ve been developing: **Ultimate Futsal Manager**.

It’s a management game in the style of Football Manager, but fully focused on futsal. You play as the head coach and control squad selection, tactics, transfers, player development, and a long-term career across multiple seasons.

I don’t actually know much about futsal, and I’m not even a fan of the sport. What caught my attention was the market: there’s almost no interaction and very few games in this space. It felt like a gap worth exploring.

# How it’s being made

This is an AI-assisted solo project. I’ve been using tools like **Claude Code** and **Grok** heavily throughout development — for planning systems, writing and iterating on code, debugging, designing game logic, and refining features through prompts and conversation.

Art and visual assets are also being created with AI (player portraits, UI elements, and other imagery), then adjusted and integrated into the game.

Because I didn’t know the sport well, I also had to build a script to scan databases and map out which clubs and players exist around the world. That script produced a large part of the data now included in the game. All of those names were changed to fictional players, clubs, etc.

The game supports a community/user-made database through a link or a file. That file can be downloaded in-game and then edited manually. When applied, it automatically replaces the fictional data with real player names, clubs, logos, and photos. You never need to download photos or logos separately to apply them.

# Current status

The game is around **75% developed**. The Steam page is live, but there’s no release date yet — it’s in active development.

# Features planned / in progress

* Realistic match simulation
* In-depth transfer system
* Player development
* Multi-season career mode
* Full tactical management (the pace and intensity of futsal should really matter)
* Option to add community-created databases with real player names, clubs, and photos
* **2D match engine confirmed** (a 3D engine is still being worked on, with no timeline yet)

If you like management games, futsal, or AI-assisted indie development, adding it to your Steam wishlist helps a lot.

Steam link:  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4909540/Ultimate\_Futsal\_Manager/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4909540/Ultimate_Futsal_Manager/)

Happy to answer questions about the game, the systems, or the AI-assisted workflow. Feedback is very welcome. Thanks!
